contract: Repository test sources executed by Quality CI must not silently introduce direct outbound network-client APIs without an explicit contract review.
limitations: Source-level guard only. It does not prove an OS-level egress sandbox and does not fully exclude indirect networking through imported application modules.
boundary: No product/UI/schema/domain behavior, no sudo, no new workflow permission, no secret, no OIDC, no dependency installation and no browser/device gate promotion.
